title: Choose the comparison day
description: Choosing a date rebases each series to 100 so growth can be compared from the same starting point.
useCase: Compare relative change across series with different raw scales.
interaction: Select a date in the chart, or use arrow keys, Home and End to move the baseline.
reducedMotion: Series values update immediately. The baseline peg skips its 160 ms transition for keyboard input, reduced motion and inactive hosts.
limitations: Four fixed, positive fictional traffic series. No live analytics, financial returns or statistical inference. Configuring series or observation counts resets the selected baseline.
look: Warm-white chart card with cobalt, brick and ink lines, a dark baseline peg and compact raw-value summaries.
motion: Selecting a date recalculates every path immediately and moves the dashed baseline peg over 160 ms. All available series meet at index 100 at that date.
adapt: `Chart` divides each value in `SERIES` by its selected baseline and derives the vertical range. The `.nb-peg` transform is the only animated chart property. `DEFAULT_CONFIG` and the `config` prop expose fixture size, raw values and peg timing.
